instruction: Make Calibri the default font for all new documents in LibreOffice Writer

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing the default font for LibreOffice Writer to Calibri. The evaluator checks the LibreOffice configuration file (registrymodifications.xcu) to verify that the Standard font setting under DefaultFont is set to 'Calibri'. Nearly identical pattern to original task which sets Times New Roman.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly targets LibreOffice Writer default font configuration file (registrymodifications.xcu)
XML parsing logic uses correct XPath: /org.openoffice.Office.Writer/DefaultFont with property 'Standard'
Metric function correctly receives rules dictionary as second parameter and accesses rules['font_name']
Expected value 'Calibri' is semantically correct for the task instruction
Complete coverage: instruction requires setting Calibri as default font, evaluator verifies exactly that
No postconfig needed: configuration file is persistent and doesn't depend on UI state
Edge case handling: returns 0 when config_file_path is None/empty
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Exception handling returns None implicitly instead of explicit 0, though this likely evaluates as failure (falsy) in practice
